16 | Fire Armor | caster | 1 min/lvl | self | U
17 | Call Flame I | 10'x10'x10' | 1 rnd/lvl | 10' | E
18 | Fire Cloak III | caster | 1 rnd/lvl | self | F
19 | Control Flames True | 50'R | C | 100' | F
20 | Forge Fire | 1 fire | C | 10' | F
25 | Lord Fire Cloak | caster | 1 rnd/lvl | self | F
30 | Blaze of Glory | 1'R/lvl | - | self | E
50 | Fire Mastery | caster | 1 rnd/lvl | varies | F

# Descriptions
@@ 1
The caster can summon a torch-sized flame to his hand. The hand will be
unharmed by the flames, though the fire is very real. If the caster strikes an
opponent in combat with his hand, there is a 50% chance that he will inflict
an 'A' Heat critical on his opponent in addition to any other damage he does.
@@ 2
Any solid inanimate, non-metal material (up to 1 cubic foot per level) can be
warmed 100° F at a rate of 1 cubic foot per round of concentration.
@@ 3
Causes one flammable object to burst into flames. Fire is normal and can be
put out by the usual methods.
@@ 4
Caster can cauterize any one bleeding wound that is bleeding 5 hits per round
or less. The target takes 2 concussion hits for each hit per round the wound
was bleeding. This stops the bleeding, but leaves an ugly scar.
@@ 5
Caster is totally protected from natural heat up to 200° F and adds +10to RRs
versus heat and -10 to elemental fire attacks.
@@ 6
Caster is bathed in flames. Anyone who comes within 1' of the caster will take
an 'A' Heat critical. The caster is unharmed by these fiames, but the cloak
provides no protection from other elemental attacks (including fire).
@@ 7
As ignite, except 1 object per 2 levels of the caster are ignited.
@@ 8
As Resist Heat, except protects against all natural heat and fire and modifies
spells involving heat and fire by -20.
@@ 9
A bolt of fire is shot from the palm of the caster. Resolve attack on the Fire
Bolt Attack Table.
@@ 10
Caster can control the movement and spread of flames within the area of
effect. The caster can cause flames to spread in a specific direction at the
rate of 1' per round to 10' per round depending upon the fuel. The fire itself
can be caused to suddenly flare in areas to attack targets within the area of
effect causing an 'A' Heat ciitical to any target within the area of effect
(the whole area must be aflame). The caster can only cause the fire to flare
in such a way every other round. The caster can concentrate on a different
area each round.
@@ 11
As Fire Cloak I, except causes a 'B' Heat critical.
@@ 12
A 1' diameter ball of fire is shot from the palm of the caster. Upon reaching
its target, it explodes to affect a 10'R area. Resolve attack on the Fire Ball
Attack Table.
@@ 13
As Lesser Firebolt, except range is 100'.
@@ 14
As Ignite, except 1 object per level of the caster is ignited.
@@ 15
Caster creates a wall of fire that is 10' high and forms a 10'R circle (6''
thick) with the caster at the center (the wall will not move with the caster).
@@ 16
As Resist Heat, except protects against all natural heat and fire and modifies
spells involving heat and fire by 20, reduces damage from fire by half, and
reduces heat criticals by one level.
@@ 17
Caster creates a 10'x10'x10' cube of flame. The cube takes a complete round to
form and be effective. Anyone passing through (or that is caught inside) the
cube takes an 'A' Hear critical.
@@ 18
As Fire Cloak I, except causes a 'C' Heat critical to anyone touching the
caster and an 'A ' Heat Critical to all within 5'R of the caster.
@@ 19
As Control Flames, except area of effect is 20'R, caster can cause a flame to
spread at a rate of 3' per round to 30' per round depending on the fuel. Also,
the caster can cause 'B' Heat criticals from sudden flare up of the flame.
@@ 20
Caster can enchant any normal fire to an intense heat. This fire will burn
anything remotely flammable and can be used to melt or weaken most metals. Any
metal item made at a forge from such an enchanted flame becomes magical with
no bonus and no other abilities. These weapons can affect creatures that can
only be affected by magical weapons. The use of this spell does not modify the
normal time to create any such item.
@@ 25
As Fire Cloak, except causes a 'D' Heat critical to anyone within 1' of the
caster and an 'B' Heat Critical to all within 10'R of the caster.
@@ 30
With this spell, the caster causes an explosion of fire. The attack is
resolved as a +100 Fire Ball delivering double concussion hits. The caster is
at the center of the attack, but takes half damage.
@@ 50
Caster can use one lower level spell from this list each round.
